title: Silver Oak Capital Case Studies
summary: Index/listing page of Silver Oak Capital's case studies, described by the search tool as a UK mortgage and lending firm's "Client Mortgage Success Stories" listing covering complex loan and mortgage deals. Deals named in the index snippet [a]: a £1m revolving credit facility for a housebuilder; a £4m bridging loan secured against a central London property; a £3.6m bridging loan on a Kensington property; a £1.46m refinance on an unencumbered residential property in Prime Central London; a £3.5m refinance; a yacht finance deal; a Manchester office financing; a purpose-built student accommodation (PBSA) lending case. The index snippet is truncated and gives no full details, outcomes or dates. Search [b] surfaced individual case-study pages with deal detail (paraphrased by the tool): £3.6m Kensington first-charge bridging facility completed within four weeks at 0.78% per month BBR-linked after two specialist lenders withdrew over intercreditor disagreements; £19m North West London bridging refinance of a partly built (c.80% complete) 25-apartment scheme at 0.75% per month, 12-month term, max 73% LTV, 15% personal guarantee; £800,000 central London bridging refinance for a Kenyan national with no UK credit profile, property originally bought at auction on a bridging loan, refinanced like-for-like onto a 5-year fixed at 4.19% and 75% LTV; Cap Ferrat villa (near Monaco) bridging of €5m at 62.5% LTV, 0.55% per month over 24 months for a repeat client who had previously used Silver Oak for a London bridging loan. A separate Cotswolds case study (/case-studies/cotsworlds-listed/) describes an £8m loan at 70% loan-to-GDV over 24 months with interest rolled up, priced at 3.95% plus Bank Base Rate with a 1% bank fee and a 1% exit fee. No meta description, FAQ, calls to action or page dates were revealed.
